title: Wear OS bug aaps 3.0.0.1
symptom: The watch face displays only readings that it received at real time, so if you set a watch face, you must press 'resend all data' on wear tab of phone app to see your graph for past few hours. Also, if the watch disconnects from the phone for 30 min at night, upon waking there is a 30 min gap in readings which doesn't really exist.
fix: The issue is fixed in the dev branch of the wear OS app; updating just the wear OS app to the dev branch while keeping the phone app on release 3.0.0.1 resolves the problem.
evidence_quote: there are many improvements on the wear os app now available on de dev branch. Including fixes for the issue you describe. If possible you can test it with the dev branch by updating just the wear os app.
